tables.name: Ambassador Bond
rows: I love my home and feel the weight of my responsibility to represent it well.
I was blackmailed by someone back home into taking up this mission.
I have fallen in love with someone from outside my home, and now my loyalties are torn.
Although I am working for the authorities in my homeland, I am actually a double agent for a different faction back home.
I leapt at the chance to leave my homeland because I did something unforgivable.
I have children back home, and I must work to secure a safer world for them.

tables.name: Ambassador Flaw
rows: My enthusiasm for the new things around me can become overbearing.
I can never fully relax.
When I am met with suspicion, I react in kind.
My thoughts are always far from the present moment.
I enjoy using my unusual status to make others feel off balance.
I get envious of the nobility and upper class folk I get to mingle with.

tables.name: Ambassador Ideal
rows: Connection. Communication is the antidote to conflict. (Good)
Respect. Guests should abide by the laws of their hosts. (Lawful)
Adaptability. Change yourself to suit the situation. (Chaotic)
Open Minded. It is natural that things will be different in different places. (Neutral)
Conniving. Learning about others is the first step to manipulating them. (Evil)
Mending. Even the most damaged relationship can be mended with good mediation. (Good)

tables.name: Ambassador Personality Trait
rows: I have been to many places and I love to talk about them.
I collect local currencies from every different region that I visit.
I come from humble beginnings and look to prove myself to the world.
I am eager to experience everything new around me.
I write the name of every person I meet in a notebook so I don't forget them.
I am sometimes overtaken by homesickness and melancholy.
I believe a firm handshake is the best first impression.
I try to learn at least twenty words of the language of each new place before I visit.

tables.name: Bandit Defector Bond
rows: I did some hard time in Alderheart's prison, and the perch guard who arrested me still has it out for me.
I stole something valuable from the Captain of my unit. I'm in big trouble if they ever find me.
I harbor a terrible secret that might change how people think of me if it got out.
I still sympathize with the Coalition's aims, I just believe there's a better way.
My friends in the Coalition didn't understand why I had to leave. They've branded me a traitor.
I had people in the Coalition who looked up to me as a leader. They might still follow me, if I could only reach them.

tables.name: Bandit Defector Flaw
rows: I'm always ready to bail when something goes wrong.
Whenever I see something valuable, I can't help but think of a way to steal it.
It's hard for me to trust people. I've been burned before.
I have a problem with authority. Nobody tells me what to do.
There's a warrant out for my arrest.
I have a bad habit that I picked up on the road.

tables.name: Bandit Defector Ideal
rows: Repentance. I've done terrible things in the past, and I want to try and make up for them. (Good)
Nature. I've seen what's happening to the forest, and it's bigger than all of us. We're all doomed unless we do something about it. (Neutral)
Friendship. My friends are like family to me, and I'll keep trying to do right by them until the end. (Good)
Self-Preservation. Any good rat knows when it's time to flee a sinking ship. I want to be clear of the Bandit Coalition when it goes down. (Evil)
Compassion. The struggle between humblefolk and birdfolk will only lead to more bloodshed. It needs to stop somewhere. (Good)
Freedom. I just want to be free to live my own life, and make my own way in the world. (Chaotic)

tables.name: Bandit Defector Personality Trait
rows: I am plucky and confident in my abilities, at least, that's what I want others to think.
I often crack jokes to lighten the mood.
I like to keep my secrets, and those who try to pry into my life irritate me.
I have trouble sleeping unless I'm on the ground (or floor) in my bedroll.
I picked up many stories during my time on the road, and I have one for every occasion.
You mess with my friends, you mess with me.
I never really had a plan in life, I tend to just go with the flow.
I'm as cautious as they come.

tables.name: Bandit Specialty
rows: Lookout
Lifter
Tug
Runner
Hustler
Captain

tables.name: Courtier Bond
rows: I'm scared my friends won't like me if they find out who I truly am.
I was very close with someone at court, but they betrayed me.
I believe the tales of chivalry that I grew up hearing and want to be the kind of gallant noble that exists in stories.
I hate the court I grew up in and hate the marks it left on my personality even more.
I love the opulence and comfort of court life.
I was raised by a nursemaid who I love like a mother. I know her far better than my own parents.

tables.name: Courtier Flaw
rows: Raised in opulence, I am unaware of my own privilege.
I don't respect the time of others.
I fall back on stiff politeness, finding it hard to connect with others.
I judge folk for their lack of refinement.
I am terrified of the world beyond the familiarity of the court.
I treat my relationships with others as trinkets to be tossed aside when they no longer entertain me.

tables.name: Courtier Ideal
rows: Dignity. Respect causes the relationships between folk of all kinds to flourish. (Lawful)
Sincerity. Even though it may hinder my prospects, I want to live according to my truth. (Good)
Caution. Decisions are best made after careful deliberation of all sides. (Neutral)
Dominance. Power and privilege are mine by right. (Evil)
Liberty. I will never let myself be stifled by stuffy manners again. (Chaotic)
Change. I will be part of the revolution, whether from the inside or the outside. (Chaotic)

tables.name: Courtier Personality Trait
rows: I love to gossip.
I'm deeply awkward outside of the social situation I grew up in.
I'm highly aware of other folks' comfort and discomfort in social situations.
I wield my refined manners with the elegance of a rapier.
I see every interaction as a transaction.
Etiquette is very important to me.
I have an endless supply of amusing anecdotes.
I have a strong sense of duty and propriety.

tables.name: Community Place
rows: I am considered weak or unskilled and many treat me like a fledgling.
I am looked upon as a traitor to my people.
My family wants me to return to the perch, but I just can't.
I am not welcome back in my home perch.
I am viewed as an oddity, someone for others to laugh at and tease.
I have found a new community on the forest floor.

tables.name: Grounded Bond
rows: My family has been the subject of ridicule ever since I left my home perch.
A bully from my childhood now holds a position of power in my home perch.
I follow the teachings of a wise outcast I met in my travels.
I feel kinship to a culture outside my own.
I won't tolerate anyone who insults me or my friends.
I have found a new family on the forest floor, and they mean more to me than anything.

tables.name: Grounded Flaw
rows: I am incapable of action when I'm at great heights.
I lash out at the slightest insult.
I keep a distance from others so they won't learn of my fears.
I project my insecurities onto others.
I am uncouth and mannerless.
I find hard to trust other birdfolk.

tables.name: Grounded Ideal
rows: Adversity. Others think of me as weak, but I will prove my worth with hard work and determination. (Lawful)
Encouragement. I try to seek out and support others like me who are seen as outcasts. (Good)
Exploration. I yearn to experience unique cultures and discover new places. (Chaotic)
Safety. In this dangerous world, it's best to keep your head down and stay cautious. (Neutral)
Rebellion. Who cares what others think of me, so long as my actions reflect how I feel in my heart? (Chaotic)
Compromise. The best way to respect each other's differences is to find a solution that doesn't exclude anyone. (Good)

tables.name: Grounded Personality Trait
rows: I always second guess my choices.
I have learned to not let the comments of others affect me.
I'm eager to show the benefits of my unique perspective.
I'm slow to trust someone new, but open up over shared hardships.
I manufacture difficult situations to prove my abilities.
I get embarrassed easily, even when someone tries to compliment me.
I will deny my fears to everyone.
I want to see how others handle situations I'm afraid of.

tables.name: Seaborn Bond
rows: The crew of my ship is closer to me than family.
A sea beast sank my ship. I will have my revenge.
The sea holds many dangers, and my superstitions keep me safe.
A wise weather watcher took me under their wing as a child and taught me so much.
From my first steps on land, I knew that something special awaited here for me.
As a child, I saw something glinting in the depths. I've always longed to find that treasure.

tables.name: Seaborn Flaw
rows: My recklessness causes trouble for myself and others.
I owe a great debt that I ran up gambling and would do anything to get free of it.
I can't stand anyone telling me what to do, even when I don't know best.
I am wracked by guilt over saving my own life over the life of a crewmate. No one can ever know
what I did. I'm lazy and spend more time getting other people to do my job than doing it myself.
I like to make myself feel important by lying about the things I've seen and done.

tables.name: Seaborn Ideal
rows: Compassion. It's my duty to help anyone stranded or lost. (Good)
Acceptance. When strong winds blow, all we can do is let them take us where they will. (Chaotic)
Order. A ship can only sail if everyone understands their place on it. (Lawful)
Opportunistic. The sea takes what it pleases, and so do I. (Evil)
Curiosity. The seas have so many secrets, and I want to discover them all. (Neutral)
Understanding. By watching the waves, the stars, and the clouds, we can better care for our seas. (Good)

tables.name: Seaborn Personality Trait
rows: I long for new horizons.
I feel uneasy and unbalanced on land, no matter how long I am ashore.
The sea might claim me any day, so why not have some fun first?
I'm very ambitious. Someday, I'll be captain of my own ship.
I am very superstitious. The slightest misstep might bring misfortune to us all.
I love being helpful and jump to take care of any task I see undone.
I know dozens of sea tales and love gathering more wherever I go.
Going to new places and meeting new folk thrills me.

tables.name: Underscout Bond
rows: My first close friend was a burrowing animal who I learned a lot of survival skills from.
A family member was a famous underscout, and I have been living in their shadow forever.
I lost someone important to me while on a difficult delve.
I see my party as my responsibility, I need to keep them safe.
I need to return to the underground regularly, even if it's just briefly.
My burrow home was taken from my family when I was young, and I want to take it back someday.

tables.name: Underscout Flaw
rows: I struggle to find things to talk about with surface dwellers.
I always have dirty on my fur, skin or feathers, and it puts some people off.
I am a picky eater, if something is too complicated or expensive I won't enjoy it.
If I see a cave opening or an unexplored path, I can't help myself from investigating it.
I have a hard time sitting still for long periods of time.
I lose track of time very easily.

tables.name: Underscout Ideal
rows: Learning. The underground is full of profound knowledge that can teach us a lot. (Good)
Expansion. There is a whole world beneath the earth ready to be conquered. (Evil)
Treasure. Where there is stone and dirt, there are goodies to uncover. (Neutral)
Wandering. Naturally forming cave networks mean you never know where you might end up. (Chaotic)
Protection. The deep dark places of the world hide many dangers to defend against. (Lawful)
Healing. Much of Everden's wounds can be healed by going to its roots. (Good)

tables.name: Underscout Personality Trait
rows: I love getting lost to see where I end up.
I prefer sleeping in slightly cramped spaces.
I always have rocks and pebbles in my pockets from the various places I've explored.
I find camping outdoors under an open sky to be a bit intimidating.
I speak to bugs and critters like they are my close friends.
I love to cook with subterranean ingredients, like roots and mushrooms.
I don't mind getting a bit dirty, and often do so on purpose.
I like leaving messages along the routes I take for other explorers to find.

tables.name: Acceptance
rows: I am truly blessed and have power over the wind itself.
I am devoted to the wind spirits, in action and title.
I believe in nature and goodness.
I will work tirelessly to earn the respect of those who give me this title.
I accept this honor but have my doubts.
I feel nothing for this title, and carry it against my will.

tables.name: Wind-Touched Bond
rows: I am guided by a wise elder who prepares me for my destiny.
I am estranged from my parents who don't believe in my blessing.
I seek to discredit the person who burdened me with this moniker.
I live in the shadow of my mentor, seeking their approval.
I have a sibling who is not blessed, which causes tension
I am one with the wind. Personal relationships are fleeting.

tables.name: Wind-Touched Flaw
rows: I can't accept another's suggestion once I've set my path.
I expect nothing less than reverence from common people.
I blindly trust in the power of my blessing.
I am overly concerned about how others see me.
I will prove my worth, even if it means putting myself and my friends in danger.
I am burdened with responsibility, and find it hard to make even the simplest decisions.

tables.name: Wind-Touched Ideal
rows: Responsibility. The powers I have been gifted with are meant to serve the common good. (Good)
Heroism. The wind chose me to be a brave warrior and leader, so shall it be. (Lawful)
Egotism. My powers situate me above others. The masses should know their place. (Evil)
Mysticism. Connected to nature, I speak for the wind and divine its will for others. (Neutral)
Cynicism. What matters isn't whether or not my powers are genuine, but what advantages I can reap because of that belief. (Evil)
Naturalism. The wind speaks to my soul, and I am bound to go wherever it directs me. (Chaotic)

tables.name: Wind-Touched Personality Trait
rows: I never back down from a challenge.
I always end up being the center of attention.
I am gifted by the wind and destined for greatness.
I have no time for those who doubt me.
I seek out challenges to test myself.
I am better than everyone else.
I avoid showing my power at all costs.
I remain humble despite my blessing.
